_comment_for_reviewers: MacroThis Chrome Extension - Provides AI-powered financial analysis for Twitter/X tweets. Only processes content when users explicitly click analysis buttons. No personal data collection.
name: MacroThis
description: AI-powered macroeconomic analysis and investment recommendations for X (Twitter) tweets

_permissions_explanation.storage: Required to store user preferences and daily usage statistics locally in browser
_permissions_explanation.host_permissions_x_twitter: Required to inject analysis buttons into Twitter/X pages when user visits these sites
_permissions_explanation.host_permissions_api: Required to send tweet content to our secure backend for AI analysis when user clicks analysis buttons
